scale_calibration.reasoning: Floor and ceiling RANSAC+SVD planes are 1.943 units apart (tilt 0.9 deg). A plant-room clear height of 2.4-2.6 m is assumed (midpoint 2.5 m), giving 1.235-1.338 m/unit. The earlier 2.0 m door assumption gave 1.25 m/unit, which lies inside this range. Not calibrated against a measured reference.
